personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center optimized for rapid field management, glanceable status, and minimal cognitive load.

spacing.rule: Dense but glanceable. Tightly group related metadata but use 'md'/'lg' padding for separation between modules. Touch targets must be minimum 44pt.

do's: Use solid colors (surfaceSecondary/surfaceTertiary) to maintain contrast and utility.
dont's: No blur. Field service operations need stark contrast and zero rendering lag.

screens.name: Command Center
screens.purpose: A live operations hub for the owner to monitor all jobs, glance at statuses, and access Ops management tools.

states.loading: Skeleton rows indicating live data feed loading.
states.empty: No active jobs. Icon (Feather 'check-circle'), text 'All quiet on the front. No active jobs.', button 'Create Job'.
states.error: Failed to load feed. Button 'Retry Connection'.

screens.layout:
1. Header: 'Ops Hub' title. Row of 3 metric tiles (Active, Unassigned, Pending Payroll) using surfaceSecondary, big Barlow Condensed numbers.
2. Scrollable List of Job Cards. Each card (surfaceSecondary, md radius, border): 
- Top row: Status Tag (pill, e.g. 'In Progress' in brandPrimary/success), Time window.
- Middle: Client name (lg text), Location (sm text, muted).
- Bottom row: Row of avatar initials for assigned cleaners, 'Manage' ghost button.
3. Floating Action Button or Bottom sticky rail for Ops Management Tools (Booking, Templates, SMS, Payroll).

screens.name: Job Detail
screens.purpose: Command view of a specific job allowing the owner to track progress, view checklist, and directly manage the assigned crew.

states.error: Failed to load job details. Button 'Retry'.

screens.layout:
1. Banner/Header: Property image with top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Job Title overlaid at bottom left, Status pill at top right.
2. Location & Time Card: surfaceSecondary, md padding. Address, Date, Time.
3. Crew Roster Section: 'Assigned Crew' header. List of row items (surfaceSecondary, sm margin-bottom). Each row: Avatar, Name, Status (e.g., 'Working', 'Not Checked In'). Right side of row: 'Manage' button (opens bottom sheet). Below roster, an 'Assign Cleaner' button (dashed border, centered text).
4. Checklist Section: Row items with checkboxes, photo requirement indicator (Feather 'camera' icon).
5. Sticky Bottom Action: 'Start Job' or 'Complete Job' (brandPrimary background, full width, lg padding) sitting above safe area.

ManageCleanerBottomSheet.purpose: Forgiving interface to remove a cleaner or adjust their hours without leaving the context of the job.
ManageCleanerBottomSheet.layout:
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Background: surfaceSecondary.
1. Header: Cleaner Name, Avatar, and close icon ('x').
2. Action Row (Segmented Control style): Two tabs - 'Adjust Time' and 'Remove'.
3. Adjust Time View: Two input rows (Start Time, End Time) with time pickers, or a 'Total Hours' numeric input field (large typography). 'Save Adjustments' CTA (gold/warning if modifying past data).
4. Remove View: Text 'Why are you removing this cleaner?'. Radio group (Feather 'circle'/'check-circle'): 'Added by mistake', 'Called in sick', 'No-show'. 'Confirm Removal' CTA (error red background).
Touch targets must be massive (48pt) for easy tapping.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the provided user dark palette. Do NOT use default system blues or purples. Muted text should use #9AA5B4.
Implement the Command Center and Job Detail screens using clean React Native primitives (View, Text, ScrollView, Pressable).

Implement the 'ManageCleanerBottomSheet' as a highly accessible action sheet using @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Ensure the 'Remove' flow features a clear reason-selection radio group, and the 'Adjust Time' flow features oversized inputs for hours.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for numbers/metrics (if available via Expo, otherwise use a fallback condensed font like 'Oswald' or default to uppercase Inter with tighter tracking) and 'Inter' for body.
Borders should be hairline (1pt) using the 'border' (#2C3849) token. Ensure high contrast separation instead of shadows.
When displaying the 'Job Detail' banner image, apply the mandatory top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent -> surface #0E1420) so the text overlay remains perfectly legible.
In the Crew Roster list, ensure the 'Manage' button on each cleaner row has a large touch target (hitSlop or minimum 44x44pt) to prevent mis-taps in the field.
Ensure 'Start Job' / 'Complete Job' sticky bottom CTA floats securely above the iOS Home Indicator and never gets obscured by scrolling content.
